purpose: Coordinated damage/caster claims, useful effects, safe positions and actual runtime impact timing

acceptance.requiredOutcome: Coordinated damage/caster claims, useful effects, safe positions and actual runtime impact timing
setup: Use actual target-compatible weapons, caster/heal/control capabilities and harmful zones from current definitions
Provide low-HP overkill targets and a valuable alternative target
actions: Run native combat through windup, impact and effect expiry
Change target health or status through legitimate damage/effect application before a later decision
measurements: Join damage/heal/control claims to actual selected weapons and impact sequence
Capture status refresh, zone occupancy, support expiry and reservation release
required: Claims prevent avoidable overkill and redundant effects without withholding necessary damage
Useful effects occur at actual impact timing and expire cleanly
forbidden: Reserved damage counted as already applied
Unsupported spell invented for a faction
Permanent support or expired status affecting utility
acceptance.checkpointPolicy: These are planned sampling ticks, not observed evidence. At binding add exact native event-boundary samples without changing the original outer ceiling; per-event capture is required where polling would miss a transient.
